***Disclaimer and Store Notes, PLEASE READ***
All items are donated and are in pre-owned condition (unless noted otherwise).
Grab bags may contain a variety of items-Jewelry, Accessories, etc- and are not guaranteed to be of any specific value or condition. May have wearable items, New with Tags, broken items, tangled items, etc. Watches are not tested and are not guaranteed to be any specific condition. We are unable to photograph or provide details for individual items in bulk lots but have provided photos to give a representation of what is included. Please note that bulk lots are sold as-is and no returns will be accepted so please ask all questions prior to bidding.
If you have questions regarding this item please contact us PRIOR to placing your bid using the Contact link on the item listing page. While we respond as quickly & thoroughly as possible, please do not expect a response in less than 48 hours and we do not guarantee that we will be able to provide the information requested. Please take this into account when bidding.
We do not offer pick up at this time.
Items may contain unseen flaws/damage not noted in listing. Photos are part of the description. It is expected that buyers will do their own research as well and/or ask any questions prior to placing a bid. Do not bid if you are not confident in the information provided.
We DO NOT retract winning bids and will only retract bids prior to auction end if we are able during our normal business hours. RETRACTIONS ARE NOT GUARANTEED IN ANY INSTANCE. WE DO NOT REMOVE UNPAID ITEMS.
"Tested" indicates ONLY that the item has been powered on; no further testing or assessment of function has been done unless noted.
We do our best to accurately identify items but cannot guarantee complete or exact identification or function as we are not experts and we can only test items in a limited capacity.
We are not able to provide individual item details on multi item lots. BULK LOTS ARE NOT ELIGIBLE FOR RETURNS OR REFUNDS. It is likely they will contain tangled and broken items, as well as incomplete sets/pairs.
Measurements for items are approximated. While we do our best to provide sizes for single item lots, we cannot do so for multi item lots.
If sizes are not listed in the title or description, or shown in a photo, then we are unable to provide them
We do our best to show the true color/condition/etc of items in photos, but we are not expert photographers and items may appear different in person.
ALL ITEMS ARE SOLD AS IS.
*We offer combined shipping up to 20lbs shipping weight for most items for a significantly reduced shipping rate.
**WE DO NOT REMOVE, REDUCE, OR ALTER HANDLING FEES REGARDLESS OF THE NUMBER OF ITEMS PURCHASED. We DO NOT combine shipping after payment; all items must be combined at time of payment. If an item does not allow you to combine when paying it is because the item is not eligible.
Requests for combined shipping after payment WILL NOT be honored. We are sorry for any inconvenience.**
**Please retain ALL packaging (boxes, paper, etc) until you have confirmed your order is complete and correct. We will require photos of these items if a return or refund request is made, and your request will be denied if you are unable or unwilling to provide the required photos. Please see full return policy near bottom of disclaimer.**
*Orders over $100 may have signature confirmation at no expense to you to better protect your purchase. Please contact us PRIOR to shipment if you decline this service, with the understanding that we are not able to file claims or issue refunds for mis-delivered items if sig conf is declined. We are not able to remove signature conf or change shipping address after the item has left our location.
If a package is returned to us due to being undeliverable (e.g. non-pickup by recipient; unavailability of recipient; incorrect address entered by buyer; etc), we will issue a refund of the bid price only and the item will be relisted.
*"UNTESTED" indicates that the item's FUNCTION has not been tested in any way. It has not been turned on or had the function tested IN ANY WAY unless otherwise stated in the listing. This does not refer to any metal or gem testing.
*We describe gold and silver to the best of our ability. If there is not a test result on the listing or if "tested" is not explicitly stated in a precious metal listing, please assume the item was listed based on marking(s), magnet testing, & research.
Precious metal jewelry and other items may have resin, wax, or other cores; if we do not state this, it is because we do not know. We provide a total weight of the item, which is the weight of all components of the item, stated and unstated (unknown).
*Imperfections may be noted in writing or shown in photos.
*Total weight (TW) includes gems, stones, embellishments, other metals/materials, clasps, etc
*Gems are tested w/ Presidium Gem Tester II. PGTII does not differentiate between natural and lab-created gems. Gems may be natural or lab created, we are not experts in this or any other field and list gems based on the PGTII results.
*Watches, electronics, etc are Untested for function and are Sold As-Is, no returns
*Items may contain original or replacement parts.
*Props/rulers/scales/coins used to show scale are not included.
*Unless otherwise stated, please assume metals and gems are NOT precious or semi precious.
*Please note that any listings that include a metal analysis reading from our Niton™ DXL Precious Metal Analyzer will NOT be eligible for return on the basis of metal tests done by the buyer (e.g. acid tests, etc) unless they are done on the same or more advanced spectrometer, as this type of testing is highly accurate. Barring special circumstances, returns will only be considered in these instances if a reading on such a machine or a certificate can be provided from a licensed jeweler saying how the item is different than stated in the listing. If providing results from your own machine we will require photographic proof of the metal reading, proof of the type of analyzer, and proof of date of last calibration. We are not responsible for any costs incurred when getting the item tested. All questions regarding the accuracy, composition, authenticity or any other query must be asked PRIOR to placing any bids on the item*

275188563.description: This lot includes 4.9 pounds of assorted minerals, crystals, rocks, and geode specimens. The collection features a variety of raw and polished stones including quartz, amethyst, agate slice, fluorite, chalcedony, and possibly some fossilized or volcanic rocks. Also included is an abalone shell piece and a metal-wire holder with a purple amethyst cluster base, which can be used as a tealight candle holder or display stand. The stones vary in color including purple, green, clear, brown, white, and pink, and are in good used or natural condition with minor wear typical of raw mineral specimens. The metal-wire holder is noted as made in Brazil on the label. This lot is suitable for collectors, educators, or decorative displays.

275432241.description:
Natural Mineral Specimen
Amethyst and Rose Quartz Crystal Collection
Natural Stone Clusters and Points
Largest piece approx. 3.5" x 3"; Total weight 1.5 lbs
Unsigned
This diverse collection features a variety of natural mineral specimens, highlighted by a substantial amethyst druzy cluster with a characteristic dark, possibly copper or silicate-rich matrix. The lot includes six individual pieces showcasing different geological formations, including deep violet amethyst clusters, translucent rose quartz, and raw crystal points. The pieces demonstrate a beautiful range of color saturation and crystalline structures, making them excellent examples for geological study or natural home decor.
Features one large amethyst druzy specimen with a distinct teal-colored matrix back
Includes 6 individual pieces consisting of amethyst clusters, points, and rose quartz
Total combined weight of the specimens is 1.495 lbs (measured on scale)
Largest cluster measures approximately 3.5 inches in width according to Westcott ruler
Condition:
Very good natural condition. These are raw mineral specimens and feature natural inclusions, terminations, and matrix variations inherent to their formation. The crystal points are largely intact with expected minor abrasions consistent with raw extraction. No evidence of artificial dyes or repairs.
This is a pre-owned item donated to Goodwill of Northern Michigan.
